def _is_verifiable_deterministic_acceptance(
    gate_input: ModelQualityGateInput,
    dod_deterministic: tuple[str, ...],
) -> bool:
    """Return whether this contract path uses deterministic acceptance authority."""
    # Reject-only deterministic checks that can fail but never grant adequacy.
    _REJECT_ONLY_DETERMINISTIC = ("schema", "length", "no_refusal", "marker")
    has_non_reject_only = any(
        check not in _REJECT_ONLY_DETERMINISTIC for check in dod_deterministic
    )
    return (
        gate_input.task_type in _VERIFIABLE_TASK_TYPES
        and bool(dod_deterministic)
        and has_non_reject_only
    )
